<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<package xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/packaging/2013/05/nuspec.xsd">
  <metadata>
    <id>SetNet.Dialogue</id>
    <version>1.2.0</version>
    <authors>Artem Lemeshev</authors>
    <license type="expression">MIT</license>
    <licenseUrl>https://licenses.nuget.org/MIT</licenseUrl>
    <icon>icon.png</icon>
    <readme>README.md</readme>
    <projectUrl>https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet</projectUrl>
    <description>Server-authoritative branching dialogue for SetNet: define dialogue trees (nodes with text + conditional choices, each choice with an optional guard and side-effect), then client.StartAsync(id)/ChooseAsync(index) walks them server-side. Pairs with SetNet.NPC capability hand-off ("dialogue:<id>"). Rides the unified protocol. Depends only on SetNet.</description>
    <tags>networking dialogue conversation npc game setnet</tags>
    <repository type="git" url="https://github.com/Povstalez/SetNet.git" commit="7cd4d30fc745de4f7cda37604c2328c84a5c7fbc" />
    <dependencies>
      <group targetFramework=".NETStandard2.1">
        <dependency id="SetNet" version="1.2.0" exclude="Build,Analyzers" />
      </group>
    </dependencies>
  </metadata>
</package>
